sentences.text: 1 3] The issue is, whether in a given set of allegations Section 328 of the IPC can be invoked if the matter is sub-judiced before the Supreme Court.
4] In that view of the matter, there shall be ad-interim protection in favour of the Applicant till the next date i.e. 14/2/2022.

5] In the event of his arrest in C.R. No.0550 of 2021 registered 910 ABA-3104-21.doc with Kashimira Police Station for the offence punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 read with Section 34 of the IPC and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 3, 26(2), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e) and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, Applicant be released on bail on furnishing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs 25,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount.

Applicant shall attend the Investigating Officer of the concerned Police Station from 3/1/2022 to 7/1/2022 between 10.00 A.M. and 12.00 Noon and thereafter as and when directed by the Investigating Officer.
